headline: Own SIGTERM/SIGINT handlers with explicit `process.exit`
summary: Replaces the framework-default signal disposition with HermitStash-owned handlers that call `process.exit` after the daemon's shutdown phases complete. Surfaces a SEA-specific exit-code-143 quirk that the v0.8.18 through v0.8.22 series then resolves.

items.title: Deterministic shutdown via explicit `process.exit` post-teardown
items.body: `lib/daemon.js` now installs its own `SIGTERM`/`SIGINT` handlers that run the `b.appShutdown` phases and then call `process.exit(0)` explicitly. Previously a stray timer or socket could keep the event loop alive after shutdown, leaving the process pinned. Operators on the SEA build see exit code 143 on clean shutdown — that quirk is addressed at the systemd-unit + container-init layer in v0.8.20 and v0.8.22.
